input: Research ergonomic chair options for back pain

gold.taskTitle: Research Ergonomic Chairs for Back Pain Relief
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify suitable ergonomic chair options to help alleviate or prevent back pain.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this chair?
questions.description: Understanding the budget range will narrow down realistic options to research.

questions.title: Where will this chair primarily be used?
questions.description: Knowing whether it is for a home office, corporate office, or other setting affects the type of chair needed.

questions.title: What specific area of your back causes pain?
questions.description: Identifying whether the pain is in the lower, mid, or upper back helps target chairs with the right support features.

questions.title: How many hours per day do you sit in a chair?
questions.description: Daily usage duration determines how heavy-duty and well-padded the chair needs to be.

questions.title: Have you been advised by a doctor on seating needs?
questions.description: Any medical recommendations or diagnoses can guide which ergonomic features are most important.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred place to buy the chair?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user prefers online retailers, local stores, or specific brands focuses the research.

questions.title: Are there specific features you already know you need?
questions.description: Features such as lumbar support, adjustable armrests, headrest, or seat depth adjustment may already be priorities for the user.
